subject: Audit trail packaging and evidence handoff for SOC 2 / SIG requests
messages:
From: Carrie Wood <carrie@acmehealth.com>
To: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: admin activity evidence for upcoming SOC 2 / SIG review

Hi Ava,

We’re preparing for Acme Health’s SOC 2 Type II audit and our assessor has asked us to obtain a sample of admin activity logs and a description of export options. Specifically they want:

- A 30-day sample of admin activity (console/admin API actions, user/role changes, API key lifecycle)
- A 12-month snapshot summary (counts, retention policy, data fields)
- Details on how Redwood exports those logs (format, delivery, pre-signed links or S3 push)
- Any redaction/PII rules applied to exported data

Can you confirm what you can provide and an estimated delivery? We’ll need this bundled with a short mapping to SOC 2 CC6 (system operations) and SIG/CAIQ references.

Thanks,
Carrie
Carrie Wood
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Acme Health

Attachments: assessor_scope.pdf (application/pdf)
From: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Carrie Wood <carrie@acmehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity evidence for upcoming SOC 2 / SIG review

Hi Carrie — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the artifacts you described. Summary below and proposed next steps; full export options are in the attached playbook.

What’s logged (short):
- Admin console actions: policy/role edits, user invites/removals, permission changes, model pinning and rollout events.
- API key lifecycle: creation, rotation, revocation (timestamps + actor id).
- Authentication events: successful and failed sign-ins (IP, user id, timestamp) — note we do not store passwords.
- System-level actions: deployments, model variants promoted, autoscaling policy changes.
- Request-level metadata: request_id, actor_id, operation, timestamp, resource_id, HTTP status, and size metrics. We do not include full request payloads in admin activity exports (payloads may be sampled or hashed for correlation).

Retention & scopes:
- Hosted (standard): admin activity logs retained for 13 months by default.
- Dedicated (customer VPC / dedicated): 13 months by default; customers can export and store indefinitely.
- For Private/on-prem installs: retention is customer-controlled; we provide export tooling.

Export formats & delivery options:
1) Console export (ad-hoc): CSV or JSON lines via Admin Console > Audit > Export. Great for small samples (<=30 days).
2) Managed evidence bundle: we can produce a certified bundle (CSV/JSONL + manifest + mapping to SOC2/SIG controls) and deliver via a time-limited pre-signed S3 link.
3) Scheduled S3 delivery: daily/nightly JSONL batches pushed to a customer S3 bucket (requires cross-account IAM role setup).
4) Direct SFTP or secure transfer (rare) — requires pre-arranged agreement.

PII / redaction notes:
- Exports redact sensitive request payloads by default and replace with a SHA256 hash for traceability.
- User identifiers are exported as stable pseudonyms (internal_id) and can be mapped back via separate identity logs under an NDA if required.

Deliverables I propose:
- 30-day raw sample (JSONL) with minimal redaction, delivered via pre-signed link.
- 12-month summary CSV (counts by event type, retention window, notable admin events).
- Evidence manifest mapping files to SOC 2 CC6 and SIG questions.
- Admin activity export playbook (attached) with the exact commands we used and the export-scripts.sql example for on-prem customers.

Timeline:
- If you approve, we’ll assemble the 30-day sample and the 12-month summary within 48 business hours.
- Managed bundle (with manifest) within 5 business days.

I’ve attached the playbook (admin_activity_export_playbook.md) and the export script. Looping in Laura to help with the S3 delivery setup if you want automated daily exports.

Best,
Ava Chen
Security Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com

Attachments: admin_activity_export_playbook.md (text/markdown); export-scripts.sql (text/sql)
From: Jon Park <jon.park@acmehealth.com>
To: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Carrie Wood <carrie@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity evidence for upcoming SOC 2 / SIG review

Ava — quick follow-up from our assessor (copied):

1) For the 30-day sample, they need an example that includes at least one API key rotation event and one role change event.
2) They want to see a delivered CSV example and the JSONL so they can confirm field mappings.
3) Also confirm whether IP addresses in auth events are fully present or partially masked.

If you can include a short note in the manifest explaining the pseudonymization approach (how to map internal_id to user_email under an NDA), that would be perfect.

Thanks — if 48 hours is tight, a short interim sample is fine.

— Jon

From: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Jon Park <jon.park@acmehealth.com>, Carrie Wood <carrie@acmehealth.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity evidence for upcoming SOC 2 / SIG review

Thanks Jon — we’ll proceed as requested. Actions: 

- Deliver a 30-day JSONL sample that includes an API key rotation event and a role change. I’ll include both JSONL and a converted CSV example for the assessor.
- Include a manifest (evidence_manifest.csv) that documents the field mappings, pseudonymization approach, and redaction rules.
- Note on IPs: authentication events include full IP addresses in exports delivered to your S3 bucket. For the ad-hoc pre-signed link bundle we provide, IPs will be present unless you request masking — we can mask octets (e.g., 10.11.*.*) on request.
- Delivery method: pre-signed S3 link (expires in 14 days) for the initial bundle; if you want ongoing delivery we’ll request the Acme Health S3 role/ARN and set up daily pushes.

Estimated delivery: 30-day sample + CSV example + manifest by end of day Thursday (48 business hours). Managed bundle with SOC2 mapping within five business days.

I’ve scheduled a short handoff call for Thursday 10:30am PT with Laura and Dev on our side to finalize S3 details and any NDA questions — meeting invite to follow.

If anything is urgent before then, please ping me directly.

Best,
Ava

Attachments referenced: admin_activity_export_playbook.md; export-scripts.sql; evidence_manifest.csv
